Utah Scones 12 Traditional Utah Recipe
§ion;
Throughout the world, "Scones" are a type of quick bread similar to Biscuits.
Everywhere except Utah. In Utah "Scones" are a type of fluffy fry bread.
We have encountered a lot of versions of this recipe, but this is the one that gives the best results for us.
Warm Water½ Cup Sugar2 Tablespoons Yeast½ Tablespoon Flour2¼ Cups Salt½ Teaspon Oil¼ Cup Egg1 FryingOil, For
In a small bowl, combine Water, Sugar and Yeast and set aside. In a mixing bowl, combine Flour and Salt. When Yeast begins to foam, pour it into mixing bowl. Add Oil and Egg, then knead for 5 minutes. Let sit for 30 minutes to rise. Roll out into a thin rectangle, ≈9&inch; &by; 16&inch;.
Use a pizza cutter to cut into 12 pieces. (≈3&inch; &by; 4&inch; each)
Let rise for ≈15 minutes. Meanwhile start heating Oil for Frying.
Fry in hot Oil, turning once, until golden brown on both sides. (In a deep fryer, at 350°, this is ≈1½ minutes on each side.)
To eat a Utah Scone, you should make a slit on one end, then put in Sauces: Honey Butter!
(or Honey, Butter, Jam, or something similar.)
